build_mr_stft_loss: build a multi resolution STFT loss module with configurable FFT sizes and hop lengths
build_single_stft_loss: build a single resolution STFT loss module with weighted spectral convergence and magnitude loss
create_spectral_convergence_loss: create a spectral convergence loss module to compare magnitude spectrograms of predicted and ground truth signals
create_log_stft_magnitude_loss: create a log STFT magnitude loss module using L1 loss on log magnitude spectrograms
run_stft_losses: run the STFT losses module to compute both spectral convergence and log magnitude loss values
